title: ConnectSession
description: Established session context (wire snapshot). Runtimes may keep richer local state; the public wire shape stays this table.

session_id.description: Opaque session id (UUID recommended; not schema-enforced).

initiator_peer_id.description: Peer that dialed / sent first hello.

negotiated_capabilities.description: Intersection (or agreed subset) of both hosts' capabilities[]; MUST include spoke-connect when both declare it.

initial_sequence.description: First invoke request uses sequence = initial_sequence (0 for protocol version 1).
